messages.english: Field layout export
messages.translation: Utoaji wa mpangilio wa mashamba

messages.english: Google Earth field layout
messages.translation: Mpangilio wa mashamba wa Google Earth

messages.english: This file contains map-reference locations and optional field labels from your saved layout. These locations have not been surveyed. Apply layout changes before exporting.
messages.translation: Faili hii ina maeneo ya marejeleo ya ramani na lebo za hiari za mashamba kutoka kwa mpangilio wako uliohifadhiwa. Maeneo haya hayajapimwa rasmi kwa upimaji ardhi. Tumia mabadiliko ya mpangilio kabla ya kutoa.

messages.english: Export fields
messages.translation: Toa mashamba

messages.english: Selected field
messages.translation: Shamba lililochaguliwa

messages.english: All fields
messages.translation: Mashamba yote

messages.english: Include saved field labels
messages.translation: Jumuisha lebo za mashamba zilizohifadhiwa

messages.english: With labels off, the file uses generic numbered labels.
messages.translation: Lebo zikiwa zimezimwa, faili hutumia lebo zenye nambari za kawaida.

messages.english: Export field layout for Google Earth
messages.translation: Toa mpangilio wa mashamba kwa Google Earth

messages.english: Preparing field layout export…
messages.translation: Inatayarisha utoaji wa mpangilio wa mashamba…

messages.english: Could not export the field layout. Your field settings have been kept. Try again.
messages.translation: Haikuweza kutoa mpangilio wa mashamba. Mipangilio yako ya mashamba imehifadhiwa. Jaribu tena.

messages.english: The field layout, account or export choices changed. Check the current layout before exporting again.
messages.translation: Mpangilio wa mashamba, akaunti au machaguo ya kutoa yamebadilika. Angalia mpangilio wa sasa kabla ya kutoa tena.

messages.english: The current field layout is not available in this account’s saved design. Save the layout before exporting.
messages.translation: Mpangilio wa sasa wa mashamba haupatikani katika muundo uliohifadhiwa wa akaunti hii. Hifadhi mpangilio kabla ya kutoa.

messages.english: Field-layout export cancelled.
messages.translation: Utoaji wa mpangilio wa mashamba umeghairiwa.

messages.english: Field-layout KML shared. It contains map-reference locations, not surveyed boundaries.
messages.translation: KML ya mpangilio wa mashamba imeshirikiwa. Ina maeneo ya marejeleo ya ramani, si mipaka iliyopimwa rasmi.

messages.english: Field-layout KML downloaded. It contains map-reference locations, not surveyed boundaries.
messages.translation: KML ya mpangilio wa mashamba imepakuliwa. Ina maeneo ya marejeleo ya ramani, si mipaka iliyopimwa rasmi.

messages.english: Photo and blank layouts need a verified map reference before Google Earth export.
messages.translation: Mipangilio ya picha na tupu inahitaji marejeleo ya ramani yaliyothibitishwa kabla ya kutoa kwa Google Earth.

messages.english: This layout crosses the map’s date-line reference, which this export does not yet support.
messages.translation: Mpangilio huu unavuka mstari wa tarehe wa ramani, ambao utoaji huu hauwezi kutumia bado.

messages.english: The saved map reference and current measurements do not match. Check and save the current layout before exporting.
messages.translation: Marejeleo ya ramani yaliyohifadhiwa na vipimo vya sasa havilingani. Angalia na uhifadhi mpangilio wa sasa kabla ya kutoa.

messages.english: Select a saved field, or choose all saved fields, before exporting.
messages.translation: Chagua shamba lililohifadhiwa, au chagua mashamba yote yaliyohifadhiwa, kabla ya kutoa.

messages.english: A saved field, bed or path is incomplete or ambiguous. Check the layout before exporting.
messages.translation: Shamba, tuta au njia iliyohifadhiwa haijakamilika au ina utata. Angalia mpangilio kabla ya kutoa.

messages.english: This saved layout exceeds the current KML export limit.
messages.translation: Mpangilio huu uliohifadhiwa unazidi kikomo cha sasa cha utoaji wa KML.

messages.english: The field layout could not be exported. Check the current saved layout and try again.
messages.translation: Mpangilio wa mashamba haukuweza kutolewa. Angalia mpangilio wa sasa uliohifadhiwa kisha jaribu tena.
